title: Concept: Development note left in served markup
description: A TODO or FIXME comment in the response markup in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The note records what the author knew was unfinished, which is usually the weak spot an attacker would otherwise have to find by fuzzing.
applicability: Deployments that render a TODO or FIXME comment in the response markup into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The note records what the author knew was unfinished, which is usually the weak spot an attacker would otherwise have to find by fuzzing.
